claims.explanation: Nocodazole inhibits tubulin polymerization, causing mitotic arrest; selective killing likely reflects cell-intrinsic ability to survive this arrest. KRAS mutation and high ABCB1/TUBB3 expression confer protection, whereas TP53 loss and high expression of mitotic checkpoint/spindle genes (AURKB, AURKA, TOP2A) sensitize. The virtual cell and drug similarity confirm a tubulin-inhibitor mechanism.

features.basis: observed pattern (absent in sensitive, present in resistant)
Aurora B maintains nocodazole-induced mitotic arrest
top2 mutants are protected by nocodazole
virtual cell upregulation, mitotic spindle assembly
